scope: Fixed Lebesgue measure; centered axis-parallel cubes in dimension five with one common radius per cube; arbitrary L1 and all positive scales in analytic statements.
ownership: Only cube-dim-5-bounds/astra_cover015 in the independent clone; no commits or pushes; no MATLAB.
checkpoint_policy: Each verification stage writes checkpoint.json with real PID and elapsed time. Deadline 120 seconds per recoverable run, not a total computation budget. No unregistered geometry sweep.

cases.description: One 32-star, a=7/8; all-positive center radius 1, all other centers radius 2/3. Independently check all center separations, sign adjacency and common-core widths. No equal-radius assumption.

65 homothetic stars indexed j=0,...,64; radius 8^(-j); a=8191/8192; first-coordinate translation (11/4)r_j; baseline core mass (1+2^(-24))(2r_j)^5; extra mass 2^(-12) times the sum of critical cube volumes placed in the last core. Verify packet separation, dilation incidences, exact defects and raw charging. No receiver sampling.

cases.type: exact finite LP on case B
cases.description: Maximize sum retained core masses z_j subject to 0<=z_j<=mu_j and z_j<=v_j=(2r_j)^5 for every packet; 32 original cube constraints per packet coincide. Verify primal z=v and a dual using one original cube per packet. This verifies the specialized clipping calculation, not a universal global covering theorem.

analytic_tasks: Independently audit the locked upper_cover014 core lemma and local 127/4 estimate, including all radius ratios and zero-volume cores.

Prove that arbitrarily small average and multiplicity defects do not uniformly bound raw expanded-packet charging, even with witness-union ratio tending to 32; explicitly retain the receiver-defect gap.
Prove global finite-family capacity clipping and an exact conditional transfer inequality for a stable capped-core estimate.
